title: Integer coordinates of extension-by-zero unit germs
statement: Let X be a topological space, V and U open with V contained in U, and x in V. In the stalk at x of the extension by zero from U [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero] of the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], let a be the germ on V of the canonical extended unit section. Every stalk element [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] equals z times a for a unique integer z.

proof.text: Import all Sheaf.Topology.ConstantSubsheafStalkBound and use its existing proved private theorem TopCat.Sheaf.constantSubsheaf_canonical_stalks. It identifies the constant sheaf stalk with its constant value and sends each sheafification-unit germ to that value; no duplicate theorem is declared.
Apply the canonical extension-by-zero stalk isomorphism on U. Its germ equation identifies the displayed extended unit germ with the integer 1 germ.
The composite integer-to-stalk isomorphism carries z to z times the unit germ by additivity; its inverse gives existence and injectivity gives uniqueness.

theorem abelianOpenExtension_integer_germ_coordinates
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (U V : Opens X) (hV : V ≤ U) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ V) :
    let E := (abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))
    let unit := abelianOpenExtensionSection U
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) V hV
      ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
        ((Functor.const (Opens ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))ᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
        (op ((Opens.map U.inclusion').obj V)) (ULift.up 1))
    ∀ t : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := AddCommGrpCat.{u}) E.obj x),
      ∃! z : ℤ, z • (TopCat.Presheaf.germ E.obj V x hx unit) = t
